jobs.description:
About the role

As Head of T&O Controlling, you will lead a global team of finance professionals and be responsible for all financial planning, reporting, forecasting, and governance activities across the T&O organization. Acting as a trusted business partner to the COO, CFO, and senior leadership team, you will provide strategic financial insights, drive investment and performance decisions, and ensure robust controls, compliance, and operational excellence across all T&O sites.

This is your new role

- Lead and develop the Global T&O Controlling team (40+FTEs), including performance management, coaching, and capability building.
- Own the delivery of central T&O financial reporting, ensuring timely, accurate and consistent reporting across all T&O Sites.
- Provide executive‑level financial insights, turning data into clear narratives and recommendations for the COO, CFO, and senior leadership.
- Own execution of the T&O planning calendar and governance, driving consistency, accuracy, and alignment across all financial cycles (Budget, RFF, Strategic Plan).
- Lead financial analysis and support strategic projects. Ensuring business cases assess opportunities available across different scenarios and drive effective decision making within the project teams.
- Drive the CAPEX process, ensuring effective and efficient processes and procedures in place to support the business making the right investment decisions, and projects are held accountable for post investment performance.
- Ensure accurate forecasting of Capex and Opex commitments for business planning.
- Ensure effective business controls and standardized processes are in place to cover all T&O cycles, drive compliance with Nexperia SOPs and ensure controls are robust, effective and efficient.
- Serve as a key member of the T&O management team, supporting the COO and Management Team drive improvements in all areas of T&O performance.

This is you

- University degree in Finance, Accounting, Controlling, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field
- Professional qualifications as an MBA, CPA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent are an advantage
- Minimum 8 years of progressive experience in Finance and related Business processes such as Manufacturing, Supply Chain Management etc.
- Proven track record of leading and developing high-performing global teams, driving performance management, talent development, and organizational capability building
- Excellent understanding of financial controls, governance frameworks, compliance requirements, and process standardization, ensuring robust and efficient operating practices across global organizations
- Proven stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships at executive level, challenge constructively, drive change, and support strategic decision-making in a fast-paced environment
- Fluent English communication skills (written and spoken) are essential, with the ability to present complex financial information clearly and confidently to international senior stakeholders; additional languages are considered a plus

About the job

As Business Product Manager you will maximize revenue and profitability of an existing family or families of products within a Product Group’s portfolio. You own the Pricing and Go to Market (G2M) strategy for running portfolios.

The role requires profound knowledge and experience in pricing strategies, channel management and negotiation. Furthermore, a strong ability to manage a complex network of internal and external stakeholders, including customers is required.

- Develop key customer & channel strategies together with Product Group Head, Business Marketing Managers, Product Marketing Managers and GSM
- Own the pricing tactics and quote policies for all sales channels for Commercial Marketing in alignment with Product Marketing Managers, Business Marketing Managers and in line with overall Product Group target settings
- Build & maintain G2M material
- Competitor analysis: consolidate input from regions about competitor behaviors, especially pricing strategy at Distribution and OEM channel, inputting (to Industrial) for required cost down roadmaps to reach Product Group margin targets

- Establish and maintain relationships with key customers and partners in alignment with BG Marketing and GSM.

What you will need

- University degree in electrical and electronic engineering or other related discipline
- Min. 5 years’ experience in Product Marketing or Product Management in the Semiconductor industry
- Proven track record of product (lifecycle) management, with strong understanding of market trends and customer needs, preferably with exposure to international customers
- Strong individual accountability, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively
- Ability to establish lasting relationships and networks in a complex environment across different levels of hierarchies and various stakeholders in a multiple culture environment

- Knowledge of key business metrics and strong negotiation skills

jobs.occupation: C++ Software Engineer for LLRF Feedback Control for PETRA IV (Physiker/in)
jobs.description:
For our location in Hamburg we are seeking:

C++ Software Engineer for LLRF Feedback Control for PETRA IV

Limited: 2 years | Start: 01.11.2026 | ID: MMA050/2026 | Deadline: 22.09.2026 | Full-time/Part-time | Remote work possible

DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.

The MSK group manages beam feedback, radiofrequency control, specialised diagnostics, and synchronisation systems for DESY's accelerators. We are an international team of technicians, engineers, and scientists who develop, install, and operate complex devices, and embedded systems for the EuXFEL, FLASH, PETRA III, and the upcoming PETRA IV storage ring.

With the PETRA IV project, DESY is launching one of the most ambitious and innovative large-scale research projects worldwide. PETRA IV, the most brilliant synchrotron radiation source of the next generation, will be the ultimate 4D X-ray microscope, setting new standards in precision and performance. To implement the project, we are looking for motivated employees who want to get involved in a complex project with international appeal. More information about PETRA IV: PETRA IV (https://desy.de/microsites/petra-4/content/index_eng.html)

About your role:

- Development of software concepts and software architecture, including exception handling for the LLRF feedback systems of the PETRA IV project
- Review of software requirements, design, and functionalities for the PETRA IV project
- Software development and support for LLRF feedback test stands
- Integration of C++ control application into large-scale accelerator control systems
- Maintenance, refurbishment, and upgrades of control software for the PETRA III accelerator

About you:

- MSc or PhD degree in computer science, electrical engineering or similar discipline
- Excellent knowledge and professional experience in modern C++ (17/20/23)
- Good knowledge on hardware interfaces and hardware programming based on FPGAs and SoCs
- Professional experience in software development for particle accelerators or storage rings
- Professional experience in middleware of large-scale control systems such as TANGO, EPICS or DOOCS
- Good knowledge in compiling software specifications and requirements
- Self-directed with a strong focus on high-quality work
- Ability to work in a multi-disciplinary team
- Fluent in spoken and written English

Good reasons to join:

Look forward to a unique working environment on our international research campus. Respectful cooperation and the well-being of our DESY employees are particularly important to us. Gender equality is an important aspect for us. To support work life balance we offer flexible working hours, variable part-time, job-sharing models and participation in mobile work (up to 50%). You will benefit from our family-friendly and collegial atmosphere, our established health management and occupational pension provision. As a public funded employer, we offer you a secure workplace and facilitate your individual career with our comprehensive training and development opportunities. Remuneration is according to the regulations of the TV-AVH. DESY offers its employees a financial supplement for a German job ticket (Deutschland-Ticket) at both locations.

For further information please contact Martin Killenberg at +49 40 8998-3011, martin.killenberg@desy.de

Please submit your complete application documents (letter of motivation, CV and relevant certificates).

Apply now (https://www.desy.de/career/online_application/index_eng.html?p=18404:10:0&jobid=MMA050/2026&P_LANG=en)

DESY promotes equal opportunities, diversity and inclusion (https://www.desy.de/career/working_at_desy/what_we_offer/diversity__inclusion/index_eng.html) . We therefore welcome applications from people of all dimensions of diversity. The professional development of women (https://www.desy.de/career/working_at_desy/what_we_offer/equal_opportunities/index_eng.html)  is very important to us and therefore we strongly encourage women to apply for the vacant position. jobs.occupation: ERP Integration Lead (all genders) (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

Your Role:

As the ERP Integration Lead for the our Life Science business, you will lead the governance, design, and continuous evolution of the application integration landscape supporting our global SAP S/4HANA transformation program. Working closely with Business Process and IT Solution Owners, the ERP Design and Build organization, the Deployment Leads, Integrated Enterprise Solutions as well as our implementation partners, you will drive the delivery of scalable, standardized, secure, and compliant integrations between SAP S/4HANA and connected business applications. You will provide technical leadership throughout the integration lifecycle from architecture and solution design through implementation, deployment readiness, and cutover support. Your leadership will ensure a robust and resilient integration landscape that enables successful global deployments while preserving enterprise architecture principles and clean core standards.

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the end-to-end ERP Integration function within the global SAP S/4HANA transformation program.
- Own the governance, quality, and continuous evolution of the application integration landscape supporting the global ERP template.
- Define and govern enterprise integration principles, interface standards, API strategies, middleware architecture, and integration patterns across SAP and connected business applications.
- Govern technical integration decisions and ensure alignment with enterprise architecture principles, clean core strategy, and global technology standards.
- Provide leadership and governance for the design, implementation, testing, and deployment of application integrations across functional workstreams and implementation partners.
- Ensure integration consistency and technical solution integrity across multiple concurrent deployment programs while balancing global standardization with justified local requirements.
- Partner closely with Deployment Leads to enable technical deployment readiness, interface validation, cutover planning, technical issue resolution, and successful deployment execution.
- Collaborate with ERP Design and Build, Data Migration, Testing, Validation, Security, Enterprise Architecture, Digital Manufacturing, and other technology teams to deliver an integrated enterprise solution.
- Ensure application integrations are designed, built, tested, and delivered in compliance with validation requirements, and global quality standards by partnering closely with Validation organizations to support deployments into regulated environments.
- Drive planning and governance for integration readiness, interface testing, technical defect resolution, deployment preparation, and cutover activities across all integrated applications.
- Identify technical risks, interface dependencies, and architectural constraints early and proactively manage mitigation plans to support successful program delivery.
- Provide leadership and direction to internal teams, external implementation partners, SAP, and technology vendors while driving accountability, delivery excellence, and effective collaboration.
- Leverage SAP Integration Suite, SAP Business Technology Platform, APIs, event driven architecture, and emerging SAP technologies to continuously improve the enterprise integration landscape and accelerate future deployments.

Who You Are:

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
- 10 or more years of experience leading SAP integration, enterprise application integration, or large scale SAP S/4HANA transformation programs.
- Extensive experience designing and governing enterprise application integration landscapes supporting SAP and non SAP business applications.
- Strong understanding of SAP S/4HANA technical architecture, SAP Integration Suite, SAP Business Technology Platform, APIs, middleware technologies, and modern enterprise integration patterns.
- Proven leadership experience managing global technical teams and implementation partners across multiple concurrent initiatives.
- Strong knowledge of enterprise integration governance, enterprise architecture, clean core principles, cybersecurity, and SAP implementation methodologies.
- Demonstrated experience leading integration solution delivery in GxP regulated Life Science, Pharmaceutical, Medical Device, or similarly regulated industries is highly desirable.
- Deep understanding of deployment readiness, integration testing, interface validation, technical cutover planning, and transition from build to deployment.
- Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence senior business and IT leaders across global organizations.
- Outstanding communication and presentation skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business value.
- Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills with the ability to balance technology strategy, business value, operational stability, risk, and delivery timelines.
- Demonstrated ability to lead cross functional teams without direct authority in a matrix organization.
- Experience leading multiple concurrent initiatives within a global ERP transformation program.
- Fluent in English. German or another European language is considered an advantage.

This role does not offer sponsorship for work authorization. External applicants must be eligible to work in Germany.

What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

jobs.occupation: Gyrocopter Flight Instructor (m/f/d)  (Fluggerätmechaniker/in - Triebwerkstechnik)
jobs.description:
To further strengthen our international flight training activities, AutoGyro is looking for a qualified and experienced Gyrocopter Flight Instructor (m/f/d).

In this role, you will be responsible for delivering high quality flight training for gyroplane pilots in both practical and theoretical environments. You will work in accordance with applicable German and international aviation regulations as well as internal standards and contribute to maintaining and developing our global training quality.

The position combines hands on flight instruction with close collaboration across engineering, sales and after sales functions. You will operate in an international environment and represent AutoGyro towards customers and partners in a professional aviation context.

The activity is based on site at our location in Hildesheim, with occasional international assignments.

The role can alternatively be structured as a cooperation with self employed flight instructors (m/f/d) or flight schools. This includes the delivery of training under the AutoGyro framework and alignment with defined standards and procedures.

Become part of our dynamic team and actively contribute to the success of our company. You can expect attractive conditions as well as free lunch every day.

Tasks

- Delivery of flight training for gyroplane pilots in both practical and theoretical environments
- Instruction and supervision of students in accordance with applicable German and international aviation regulations and internal standards
- Execution of check flights, proficiency checks and refresher training
- Customer handover flights and aircraft familiarisation
- Assessment of student performance and documentation of training progress
- Contribution to the continuous development of training concepts and standards in line with international requirements
- Close coordination with engineering, sales and after sales in relation to aircraft and customer requirements
- Representation of AutoGyro towards customers and partners in a professional aviation context

Requirements

- Valid Flight Instructor qualification for gyroplane or a comparable instructor licence with willingness to convert
- Proven flight experience, ideally within ultralight or gyroplane aviation
- Strong instructional capability with a structured and safety oriented approach
- Sound understanding of aviation regulations and operational procedures
- High level of responsibility, reliability and professional judgement
- Confident communication skills in English and German
- Willingness to travel occasionally, including international assignments

Benefits

- Dynamic working environment with the global leader in gyroplane manufacturing.
- Comprehensive onboarding and continuous training opportunities.
- Supportive and international team culture.
- Flexible working hours (flexitime) to support work–life balance.
- Corporate fitness programme (Hansefit).
- Employer contributions to the pension scheme.
- Employee discounts via our corporate benefits platform.
- Regular company events that strengthen team spirit.
- Free daily lunch at our headquarter.
- Overtime compensation and additional paid leave for special occasions.
- Unique aviation experience – including a gyrocopter sightseeing flight.

Are you ready for an exciting career in aviation? Then become part of AutoGyro GmbH.

We are the global market leader in the development, production, and sales of gyroplanes, working with partners in more than 40 countries worldwide. Our headquarters and production facility are located at Hildesheim Airport. With state-of-the-art technologies, a high level of in-house manufacturing, and a clear vision for sustainable aviation, we actively shape the future of flight.

Since our founding in 1999, we have grown continuously and today employ an international team of nearly 100 qualified specialists and engineers. With a global sales network, we consistently pursue our mission: to make the fascination of flying, maximum safety, and the versatile applications of gyroplanes accessible worldwide.

About the roleAre you passionate about building high-performing teams, deepening client trust, and turning complex software into a tool people rely on every day?As Team Lead Customer Success, you'll take ownership of our Customer Success function for D3 and OMS clients — banks, traders and technical teams who depend on our systems to price, manage and distribute FX Forward and Swap prices around the clock. You'll lead a team of four responsible for day-to-day client support, build the processes and product expertise that are shared across the team, and shape a more proactive way of working with clients.This is not a role where you inherit a finished machine. You'll inherit a strong product, demanding expert users, a good team, and a function that needs clear ownership, deep product expertise, strong tooling, and a proactive way of working. Working closely with Product, Sales, and Engineering, you'll help define what a modern, efficient Customer Success function looks like for our market.This is a hands-on builder role for someone comfortable with ambiguity, who enjoys getting close to the product and the client as much as leading a team.
Your Responsibilities
• Lead and grow the Customer Success team responsible for D3 and OMS clients, taking on full people-management responsibility.
• Own the quality of day-to-day client support, making sure questions are answered quickly, clearly, and to a consistently high standard.
• Own support escalation, ensuring complex, urgent, or sensitive cases move through the organisation in a structured way instead of bouncing between people.
• Build the team's product expertise so that a growing share of D3 and OMS questions can be answered directly, without relying on Product, Engineering, or long-standing individual experts.
• Own onboarding from a Customer Success perspective, so new clients and users understand the product and are set up for success from day one.
• Develop a more proactive way of working with clients — anticipating issues before clients raise them, and identifying where they are not using D3 or OMS to its full potential, reaching out with suggestions rather than only reacting to requests.
• Make client knowledge visible internally by documenting client setup, usage, stakeholders, infrastructure, and recurring issues, rather than letting it live in emails or individual heads.
• Create a structured feedback loop into Product, surfacing patterns, friction, and recurring issues from client interactions, not just direct feature requests.
• Help define and improve the tools, processes, and reporting used by Customer Success, including systems such as Dynamics, Confluence, and Jira.
• Contribute to a clear, shared view of client health, including key users, setup, risks, and commercial opportunities, working closely with Sales.
• Speak directly and frequently with traders, desk heads, application owners, and technical stakeholders at client banks.

Preferred qualifications
• Several years of experience leading a Customer Success, Support, or Client Services team, ideally in enterprise software or fintech.
• A proven ability to build structure, process, and ownership in a function that is still evolving, rather than only maintaining an existing setup.
• Strong technical aptitude and the ability to develop deep expertise in a complex software product like D3. This is not an engineering role, but you need to be comfortable with technical detail and credible with sophisticated users.
• Enough financial-market understanding to grasp why D3 exists, what problem it solves, and what our traders need from it.
• Comfortable engaging directly with senior, demanding stakeholders such as traders and desk heads, as well as technical and operations teams at banks.
• Strong track record of managing escalations and keeping complex cases moving through an organisation without losing ownership.
• Experience building or improving tooling, automation, AI-assisted workflows, reporting, and documentation practices within a support or Customer Success function.
• Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working closely with Product, Sales, and Engineering.
• Fluency in English is required.

Nice to have Experience with one or more of the following would be an advantage:
• FX, Capital Markets, FICC, Treasury, or electronic trading environments.
• Previous exposure to OMS or similar trading systems.
• Enterprise SaaS support or Customer Success in a technically complex product.
• Experience building a Customer Success function in a small, expert team, with a hands-on approach to clients, product, and day-to-day operations.
• Familiarity with SaaS environments and technical operations — infrastructure, connectivity, system monitoring — even though this role does not own technical operations.
• CRM or ticketing systems such as Dynamics, Confluence, Jira, or Teams.

What we offer as an employer
• Join an Innovative Leader: Be part of a pioneering SaaS tech company recognised as the global standard in its category, experiencing impressive double-digit annual growth.
• Transform a Major Market: Contribute to our mission of revolutionising the FX Swaps market with cutting-edge solutions and technologies.
• Be part of an international workforce: Work within a truly multi-national team, collaborating with colleagues from across the globe, located in London, Hamburg, and Singapore.
• Make an Impact: Hone your skills in small teams where your ideas matter, actively shaping your role and driving your personal growth.
• Enjoy Competitive Benefits: Benefit from a competitive compensation and benefits package, including 30 days of annual paid leave.
• Invest in Your Development: Access a €1,000 (or equivalent in local currency) yearly budget dedicated to further education and professional development.

DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.

The DESY Information Technology (IT) division participates in a wide range of high-profile national and European projects, evaluating and developing innovative IT technologies. One of its key activities is the establishment of the German EOSC Node in collaboration with ten leading research institutions across Germany as part of the National Research Data Infrastructure (NFDI). This initiative requires close coordination across more than 300 German universities and research institutions, as well as with national and European research infrastructures.
To support this ambitious endeavour, we are seeking a scientist with expertise in modern web technologies, particularly the development of user-facing web portals and backend services. The successful candidate will be motivated to contribute to the design, development, and operation of these technologies within the evolving European Open Science Cloud (EOSC) ecosystem.

- You will participate in regular project meetings, workshops and conferences, both online and in person, and you will contribute to regular reports towards the project management

- You have good knowledge of Web Technologies and at least one modern programming language

About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

In order to support the Quality Conformance Management, Airbus Operations is looking for a

Bachelor student (d/f/m) in the field of Quality Management / Behavioral Science, working title of thesis "Quality NC Eradication – Behavioral Quality Management (Nudging)".

You are looking for a bachelor thesis and want to get to know the work of a Quality Conformance Manager? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in Quality department of A320 FAL Hamburg as a Bachelor Student(d/f/m)!

- Location: Hamburg Finkenwerder
- Start: As soon as possible
- Duration: 14 weeks

Your location

You will be working at one of the largest production sites for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Your benefits

- Work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime) and opportunities for mobile working after department agreement.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally (you will be integrated into a young, highly motivated team composed of members from 10 different nationalities).
- Work with modern/diversified technologies and explore the field of nudging and behavioral science inside an operational business.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Support the Quality Conformance Manager in daily tasks, including continuous quality improvement, creating KPI-Dashboards, and updating Control Plans.
- Explore behavioral science—specifically "Nudges"—as a complement to traditional quality management for your thesis project.
- Analyze human factor challenges, such as shifted attention (Prospective Memory) or underestimating risks (Availability Heuristic).
- Investigate specific use cases, for example the "Scuff Plate Protection", where titanium plates are left unprotected.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Practical knowledge of Microsoft Suite or Google Workplace
- Enrolled full-time student (d/f/m) in the area of Business Psychology, Behavioral Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or an equivalent field of study.
- First practical experience in the field of project management and/or data analysis is desirable.
- Fluent in German and English.
- Self-organized individual with high motivation.
- A genuine interest in shaping quality and a curious mindset towards behavioral science.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth. Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!
